name: Exp_CloseAllPositionsByTime
summary: This EA automatically closes all open positions at a specified time of day, serving as a scheduled risk management utility rather than a trading strategy. It iterates through all open positions and closes them when the current server time matches or exceeds the user-defined closing time. The tool is commonly used to avoid holding positions over high-risk events such as news releases or market open/close periods.
summary_zh: 该EA在每天指定时间自动关闭所有持仓,作为定时风险管理工具而非交易策略。它遍历所有持仓并在服务器时间达到或超过用户设定的平仓时间时执行全部平仓。常用于规避新闻发布或市场开盘收盘等高风险时段的持仓风险。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于时间的强制平仓,不涉及任何入场信号或技术指标分析。入场条件方面,该EA本身不开仓,仅负责在设定时间执行平仓操作。出场条件为服务器时间达到用户指定的CloseHour和CloseMinute时,遍历所有持仓并逐一平仓。仓位管理方面,该EA不涉及仓位计算或加减仓逻辑,仅对已有持仓执行全量平仓。资金管理方面,没有独立的资金管理模块,平仓后资金的释放取决于原有持仓的盈亏状态。整体上该EA是一个纯粹的时间触发型风险管理工具,策略逻辑简单直接,没有复杂的条件判断或过滤机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is time-based forced position closing, with no entry signals or technical indicator analysis involved. Regarding entry conditions, the EA itself does not open any positions; it solely executes closing operations at a designated time. The exit condition triggers when server time reaches the user-specified CloseHour and CloseMinute, at which point it iterates through all open positions and closes them one by one. In terms of position sizing, the EA does not involve any lot calculation or position adjustment logic; it only performs full closure of existing positions. For money management, there is no independent money management module, and the capital released after closing depends on the profit or loss status of the original positions. Overall, this EA is a purely time-triggered risk management utility with simple and straightforward strategy logic, lacking complex conditional checks or filtering mechanisms.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定平仓的EA魔术号(0表示所有持仓)
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to close (0 for all positions)

pros: 逻辑简单清晰,功能单一专一,不会产生意外交易行为
有效规避隔夜风险或特定高风险时段的持仓风险
可作为其他交易策略的风险管理辅助工具配合使用
pros_en: Simple and clear logic with a single dedicated function, no unexpected trading behavior
Effectively avoids overnight risk or position risk during specific high-risk periods
Can be used as a supplementary risk management tool alongside other trading strategies
cons: 缺乏细粒度控制,无法按品种或方向选择性平仓
没有平仓失败的重试机制或错误处理反馈
时间触发逻辑可能因服务器时间偏移或延迟导致平仓不及时
cons_en: Lacks fine-grained control; cannot selectively close positions by symbol or direction
No retry mechanism or error handling feedback for failed close operations
Time trigger logic may result in delayed closing due to server time offset or latency
improvements: 增加按品种、方向或魔术号过滤的平仓选项,提升灵活性
增加平仓失败的重试机制和日志记录,提高可靠性和可追溯性
improvements_en: Add closing options filtered by symbol, direction, or magic number to improve flexibility
Add a retry mechanism and logging for failed close operations to enhance reliability and traceability

risk_points: 时间触发可能因服务器延迟导致平仓不精确
批量平仓时滑点可能导致实际平仓价格偏离预期
risk_points_en: Time trigger may result in imprecise closing due to server latency
Slippage during batch closing may cause actual close prices to deviate from expected
